title: BUGFIX — Pipeline qualification fallback: synthesise clips from discovery when viral downloader returns 0
rationale: agents/scs001-orchestrator/index.ts: when ViralTikTokDownloader returns 0 clips (RapidAPI subscription lapse), clips[] stays empty, qualifiedClips=0, and the pipeline stops in 2.3s with 0 videos produced — even though DiscoveryAgent found 19 clips. Sprint 1321 added the skip-clause to avoid 10min ClipDetection timeout on empty viral clips, but left no fallback. Fix: when viralClipsCount=0 && discoveries.length>0, synthesise pre-qualified ClipQualityScore[] from discovery metadata so InsightAgent and ScriptAgent can still run. Pipeline metrics show this was happening every run on March 25 after RapidAPI 403.

tasks.description: Fix agents/scs001-orchestrator/index.ts lines 167-169: when viralClipsCount===0 && discoveries.length>0, instead of just logging and skipping, synthesise clips[] from discoveries: set clip_id=discovery_id, quality_score=50, qualified=true, score_breakdown all-10s, start/end from timestamps[0]. This lets InsightAgent and ScriptAgent run using topic metadata when RapidAPI is unavailable.
